capabilities: Interview the user about their day with AI-generated follow-up questions
Show a confirmable writing plan before anything is saved
Write daily notes with mood/energy frontmatter plus people and project notes with wikilinks
Answer questions about past notes with dated, clickable sources
Attach photos and PDFs and make them searchable memory
extras: Desktop only; mobile is not supported. Voice setup downloads about 3 GB and requires Python 3.12, not 3.13/3.14. Git auto-commit is off by default and should stay off if the vault already uses git. Free and open source (MIT) with an optional Ko-fi donation.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to capture your day through a guided conversation, or to query your own past notes with cited answers.

relations.evidence: A local AI interviews you at the end of your day and writes your journal for you — 100% local via Ollama.
text-to-speech (Kokoro) and speech-to-text (Whisper) through a small local sidecar

summary: AI journaling plugin that interviews you each night via a local Ollama model, then writes daily, people, and project notes and answers questions from your past notes.
